stage34_target: Proof-complete matching-x fiber-product Mordell-Weil sieve on E_q(Q) x J_q(Q), after both full MW groups and the receiver-x maps are exact.

S32-PW04.reused_pattern: Fix the finite quotient/class system first, compute exactly which classes are reachable, and perform downstream work only on those classes instead of repeatedly projecting unrelated local moduli by gcd.
S32-PW04.not_reused: Stage32's positive quadratic kernel, fractional-shift lower bound, Cauchy bound, Smith diagonal [1,2,2], generator orders [20,20,40], and 640 class count are Stage32-specific and receive no Stage34 credit.
S32-PW04.stage34_specialization: Choose m in {4,2} first for the E/J free MW coefficient lattice, then choose only good primes whose reduction orders are divisible by m and intersect matching-x relations in the fixed quotient.

S32-PW03.applicability_condition: Use only if a Stage34 fixed-quotient survivor relation is proved to be an affine subgroup/coset union or is expressible as exact image membership of an integral homomorphism. Then HNF/Smith can replace explicit class tables by exact congruence rows.
S32-PW03.current_blocker: Matching receiver-x is a nonlinear relation on finite elliptic reductions; no subgroup/coset structure has yet been proved.

S32-PW01.use_if: Tailored quotient survivor sets become too large to materialize but admit an exact count/rank/unrank decomposition.

S32-PW05.reason: No exact group action has been proved to preserve the Stage34 matching-x relation while giving complete orbit coverage.

live_stage32_related_pattern.use: Conceptual precedent only: reduce a cover condition to a fixed finite F2-character quotient where basis choice is noncanonical but span/rank is invariant.
